item.title: CENTCOM issues safety warning to Iranian civilians as regime uses ‘heavily populated’ areas for launches
item.summary: CENTCOM warned Iranian civilians to avoid military-linked sites, accusing Tehran of launching drones and missiles from populated areas.

item.title: White House says oil price spike is temporary as Trump pushes energy dominance amid Iran war
item.summary: Karoline Leavitt says oil price spike from Iran conflict will be short-lived as President Trump's energy dominance strategy stabilizes markets and eases pressure on American consumers.

item.title: Balkans on edge: Kosovo political crisis sparks fears of renewed instability
item.summary: Trump ally Kosovo President Osmani calls snap elections after parliamentary deadlock blocks presidential vote, creating political uncertainty in the Balkans.

item.title: State Department defends 'proactive' evacuation efforts against Dems' claims of diplomatic chaos
item.summary: Sen. Jeanne Shaheen, D-N.H., criticized the Trump administration over Middle East ambassador vacancies as the State Department defended its Iran evacuation response.

item.title: Former SJSU volleyball star opens up on living with trans teammate without knowing athlete's biological sex
item.summary: Former SJSU volleyball player alleges she unknowingly shared living space and bed with a male, as she lived with a transgender teammate.

item.title: Ex-DEA chief says he's 'never seen' cartel fight so intense as Trump weighs missiles against traffickers
item.summary: Former DEA official says Trump administration's drug cartel crackdown is unprecedented, warning America must go on offensive against dangerous cartels.

item.title: Iran-born winemaker 'thrilled' to be in US after fleeing country where alcohol is outlawed
item.summary: An Oregon winery owner with Iranian roots hopes for freedom in his homeland, where wine is banned. The founder of Maysara Winery and his daughter share thoughts on Iran's future.

item.title: Cartels fear US retaliation as Trump-era pressure reshapes strategy: 'They fear the United States'
item.summary: Mexican drug cartels reportedly avoid targeting American tourists due to fear of U.S. retaliation, especially under Trump's terrorist designation.

item.title: At least 2 dead after plane crashes into Alabama bay
item.summary: At least two dead after private plane crashes near Gulf Shores, Alabama, airport Saturday night. Multiple agencies launch rescue effort in the area.

item.title: Trump vows block on signing new laws until SAVE America Act passes Senate
item.summary: Trump threatens to block all new legislation until Senate passes SAVE America Act requiring voter ID and citizenship proof, setting up a major showdown.
